rationale: Flat diesel cost (85 $/MWh) makes minimizing total diesel energy optimal. All PV is used (no curtailment) and no load is shed. The battery has only 12 MWh of usable SOC above the floor; discharge efficiency 0.9 yields at most 10.8 MWh to load, rounded to the 2 MW dispatch step this gives 10 MWh. Discharging 10 MW in t1 keeps SOC >= 6 and respects the 12 MW discharge limit; diesel is 25/54/32 MW (all within 15-70 MW). Total diesel = 111 MWh, cost = 111*85 = 9435 USD. Charging is never beneficial because round-trip efficiency < 1 and there is no PV surplus.
